summary: AVSAR responded to an injured male hiker in the Hourglass couloir; his party of four was at the top of the Hourglass above the fixed ropes (~13,770 ft); AVSAR inserted teams by helicopter and 4x4, set a haul system to lower the subject and his party to the bottom of the Hourglass; all off the mountain by 20:22; the injured male refused all medical treatment from Alamosa EMS.
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR; REACH Air Medical
notes: From the AVSAR 2018 mission log; mechanism of injury unspecified in the log; patient-refusal, no transport.
